newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev up to 997-998 per mark, falls on dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev up to 997-998 per mark, falls on dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev opened at 997-998 per mark, firmer than 998-999 at Friday's close as foreign currency supply topped demand in light interbank volume, dealers said.
* The lev fell to 1,858-1,863 to the dollar from 1,848-1,852 at Friday's close, tracking the weakening mark/dollar on global markets.
* Local traders adjust the lev/dollar through the lev/mark and the international mark/dollar cross.
* The lev has been pegged at 1,000 to the mark as an anchor under an IMF-prescribed currency board system, a fixed exchange rate mechanism introduced on July 1 to restore confidence in the lev.
* The interbank lev/mark exchange rate may deviate by up to 0.5 percent from the currency board peg. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
